areas.areaDesc: isolated places over Dehradun, Champwat and Nainital

text_by_language.en: Light to moderate rain/snowfall (at places with an altitude of 3000 meter and above) accompanied with thunder/lightning/gusty wind (30-40kmph) is very likely to occur at isolated places over Dehradun, Tehri Garhwal, Pauri Garhwal, Champawat, Nainital in next 3 hours.
